domain: NAV COUNTERS + DATA STATE / PROVENANCE PANEL + NOTIFICATIONS
summary: Today the chrome of the portal — left nav counts, the sidebar "today" box, the 8 radar KPI cards, the 20-tile region map, the 7 source tiles, the transparency ("DEMO ENVIRONMENT") panel and the notification bell — is almost entirely fed by one object, `D.KPI` (aliased `K` at portale.html:2549), plus `D.WINDOW_KPI`, `D.FIELD_KPI`, `D.REGION_STATS`, `D.WHAT_CHANGED` and `D.NOTIFICATIONS`. Those are computed inside italy-demo-data.js from the demo fixtures (29 demo CASES, 72 demo ACTIVITIES, 56 demo SIGNALS, 53 demo SOURCES, 448-row demo ARCHIVE, 36 demo RECORDS, 39 demo PEOPLE), so every badge is a fixture number even when a real one exists. Measured, the gap is large and always in the same direction: competitors nav says 72, real is 503; science says 36, real is 88; archive says 448, real is 740; sources says 92, real is 31; "competitor movements · 30d" says 43, real is 11; the transparency panel claims 244 real / 491 demo when the real application model holds 1038 real / 100 demo records. Four numbers are honest by luck (29 windows, 6 window-open, 2 next-cycle, 5 date-unknown) because the demo CASES are a 1:1 shadow of the 29 canonical windows. The transparency panel itself is the worst offender in principle: it is the screen that promises to tell the truth about the data, and it reads the fixture (`D.ACTIVITIES`, `D.ARCHIVE`, `D.FIELD_MESSAGES`) to do it. `D.NOTIFICATIONS` is six hand-written alerts asserting field messages, window countdowns and a BASF movement that exist nowhere in the ingested data.
realSource: APP = window.ITALY_APP_MODEL. Nav and KPI counts come from APP.counts / APP.collections (windows 29 · competitorActivities 503 · scienceRecords 88 · archive 740 · sources 31 · researchers 60 · voices 17 · products 166 · marketObservations 77 · resistance 34 · channels 30 · events 18 · news 8 · futureSignals 3 · upstreamOpportunities 3). Window status buckets come from APP.collections.windows.records[].status (upstream CURRENT_STATUS). Verified portfolio matches come from window.ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS (VERIFIED 12 / NOT_FOUND 7) — which italy-app-model.js does NOT read yet. Regulatory use rows come from IG.LINKS (219). Source-group tiles come from IG.SOURCES[].TYPE (31 records). The transparency panel comes from APP.provenanceSummary. Field Sales KPIs stay on D.FIELD_MESSAGES as an explicitly labelled optional-integration demo (§5).

risks: The transparency panel's layers overlap. products (166) already contains regulatory (163) and commercial (44); archive (740) re-indexes science, market, competitor, voices, events, news and windows. A naive sum of all 20 model layers reads ~1800 and would be a new, larger lie than the one being fixed. The panel must either use a curated non-overlapping row set or mark every contained row explicitly. This is the single highest-risk item in the domain.

Four radar numbers do not move (29 / 6 / 2 / 5 / 16) because the 29 demo CASES are a 1:1 shadow of the 29 canonical windows. It will look as though nothing was fixed. It was: the source changed from a fixture to the canonical contract, so the next data load moves them. Say this explicitly in the handoff or someone will 'revert the no-op'.
Nav badges move in both directions and one is a 7x jump (competitors 72→503). Anyone who has memorised the demo numbers will read the change as a bug. Publish the before/after table with the change.

Repointing the source group chips (portale.html:3346) at the model will empty the source LIST unless the derived group field lands first — AM sources currently have group: null for all 31 records, so every group filter returns zero. Order matters: model change first, view change second.

The news period chips (portale.html:3348) filter on a .days field that exists only on the demo news objects. The real IG.NEWS records have DATE strings only — including one literal 'NAO SEI' and two items from 2021/2022. Repointing news at the model without adding a daysFrom(DATE) projection makes those chips read 0.

Deleting the notification bell removes the only 'live' affordance in the header. Expect pushback that the portal now looks static. It is static: one reference date, no stream. The honest answer is that the bell was simulating a service that does not exist.

89 of 503 competitor activities (17.7%) have no start date, all of them ORGANIC_VIDEO. Any recency counter silently drops them. If the caveat is not rendered, the 30-day figure of 11 quietly implies the other 492 were older, which is not what the data says.

AM.products[].links — the source of the current 13 verified matches — are themselves built from D.CASES inside italy-app-model.js (lines 102-105). Fixing the KPI to read ITALY_LABEL_VERDICTS does not fix the underlying link graph, which is still fixture-fed. That belongs to the portfolio domain but will contradict this domain's 12 if it is not aligned.

APP.counts.news is 8 while D.NEWS is 9 (ITALY_REAL.NEWS). Two news corpora are live simultaneously. Whichever the sources screen ends up rendering, the tile label and the list must come from the same one.

italy-i18n.js needs roughly nine new layer-label keys plus a rewritten t.dsNote. Missing keys fall back to the English literal in the || expressions, which will silently ship English strings into the Italian default (§11).
openQuestions: KPI card 7 ('links', currently 80): delete it, or keep the slot and rebind to the 219 real label use rows with a new label? These are different facts and the card cannot straddle them. Product decision, not an engineering one.

Should the notification bell be deleted outright, or kept inert with a single 'NESSUN SERVIZIO DI NOTIFICA COLLEGATO' row? Deleting is the honest minimum; keeping it inert preserves the header rhythm at the cost of a control that does nothing.

Does the transparency panel show all ~15 model layers, or a curated subset? All 15 is more complete but forces overlap notes on 4 rows; a subset is cleaner but is itself an editorial choice the panel should disclose.

'People monitored': one tile (66 distinct names, dedupe rule stated) or two (15 with documented role · 60 researchers in scope)? Two is more truthful — the sets are not the same kind of evidence — but adds a tile to a row already at 7.

The sources nav badge: 31 (sources only) or 31 + people? The screen shows both sources and people behind that one nav item, so 31 slightly under-describes it. Recommend 31 with the people tiles carrying their own numbers.

Canonical windows are placed in the 'derived' column with the note 'expected agronomic norms'. Measured, 24 of 29 carry DATE_STATE = EXPECTED_NORM and 5 DATE_TO_CONFIRM, so 'derived' is defensible — but they are the CANONICAL layer, the highest precedence in the contract. Real, derived, or split 5/24? Needs an upstream ruling.
Should the 740-row archive index appear in the panel at all? It is real work and real traceability, but as a number in a real/derived/demo table it invites double counting.
